How much does it cost to run a baby bottle steriliser?

A typical baby bottle steriliser uses about 650 watts (500–800W depending on the model). Used for 8 minutes per use, 7 uses a week, it costs about 2.3p per use and £8.30 a year at the current price cap rate.

Cost per use
2.3p
About £8.30 a year at 8 minutes per use, 7 uses a week.

Standing charge not included.

Ways to cut the cost

  • Check the power rating on the plug or label for the most accurate figure.
  • A plug-in energy monitor shows exactly what a device uses.
  • Turn things off at the wall when not in use.

Questions

How much does it cost to run a baby bottle steriliser per hour?

At 26.32p/kWh, a 650W model costs about 17p an hour while it's running.

How much does it cost to run a baby bottle steriliser per year?

About £8.30 a year, based on 8 minutes per use, 7 uses a week. Change the sliders above to match how you use yours.

Is the standing charge included?

No. You pay the standing charge every day whether or not the appliance is used, so it isn't part of the cost of running it.

How do I find my baby bottle steriliser's actual power use?

Check the rating label, plug or manual for the wattage, or the energy label for kWh figures. A plug-in energy monitor shows exactly what it uses.
